# coreweave_service_account_oidc_trust_config (Resource)

Creates and manages an OIDC trust rule for a CoreWeave service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coreweave_workload_federation_oidc_config" "github" {
  name       = "github-actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  audience   = "https://api.coreweave.com"
}

resource "coreweave_service_account" "github_actions" {
  id              = "github-actions"
  organization_id = "a1b2c3"
  display_name    = "GitHub Actions"
}

resource "coreweave_service_account_oidc_trust_config" "main" {
  id                                 = "main-repository"
  organization_id                    = coreweave_service_account.github_actions.organization_id
  service_account_id                 = coreweave_service_account.github_actions.id
  workload_federation_oidc_config_id = coreweave_workload_federation_oidc_config.github.id
  description                        = "Trust workflows from the main repository"
  cel                                = <<-EOT
    token.repository == "example/example" &&
    token.ref == "refs/heads/main"
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cel` (String) The CEL expression evaluated against verified OIDC token claims exposed through the `token` namespace.
- `id` (String) The caller-chosen trust configuration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) The six-character ID of the owning CoreWeave organization.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account that owns this trust configuration.
- `workload_federation_oidc_config_id` (String) The UID of the workload federation OIDC configuration used to verify tokens.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the trust rule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) The canonical resource name.
- `uid` (String) The server-generated unique identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The RFC 3339 last-update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coreweave_service_account_oidc_trust_config.main
  id = "organizations/a1b2c3/serviceAccounts/github-actions/oidcTrustConfigs/main-repository"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coreweave_service_account_oidc_trust_config.main organizations/a1b2c3/serviceAccounts/github-actions/oidcTrustConfigs/main-repository
```
